To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the proposed method is effective in ranking text units according the three textual criteria considered, i.e., textual saliency, connectivity and topic aptness, and (2) the method is efficient in terms of time and space complexity.

a) the use of lexical cohesion in the context of a corpus-based approach to text analysis can lead to the automatic identification of text units that contribute to the definition of a text's meaning, b) the same method is also able to identify the most cohesive text segments, and c) the method can be applied to identify the text units that address the main topics of a text.

1) lexical cohesion can be exploited to build a text representation that is able to provide an accurate and efficient measure of textual saliency and textual connectivity; 2) topic aptness can be measured by combining the textual saliency measure with the textual connectivity measure; 3) the proposed measures of textual saliencies, textual connectivity and topic aptness are able to improve the effectiveness of the summarization process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a method for ranking text units based on the analysis of lexical cohesion.
the development of a method for ranking text units in terms of their contribution to a text.
the automatic analysis and representation of text in order to support text processing applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is a very efficient one to use lexical cohesion to rank text units in terms of textual saliency, connectivity and topic aptness.
the method described is an efficient and effective means of ranking the text units in a document in terms of their contribution to the meaning of the document as a whole.
the method described here is able to produce a ranking of text units according to textual saliency, connectivity and topic aptness, and that the results are promising.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed approach to text unit ranking is a useful and efficient method for summarizing texts, which can be used to build a system capable of providing a variety of different types of summarization.

the method proposed is a simple and efficient way to rank text units in a document according to their importance in defining the meaning and structure of a text and the extent and aptness to which they address its subject matter.

the method proposed is able to identify text units that are semantically relevant to the subject matter of a text and that are able to form a cohesive text, and to rank them accordingly, thus providing a useful tool for text summarization and for other applications where a selection from a text is required.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of lexical cohesion can be very effective for text summarization, but that its effectiveness is strongly dependent on the way the lexical cohesion is exploited.
the method described is capable of identifying the text units which are most relevant to the subject matter of a text, and of identifying the text unit which best defines that subject matter.
the use of lexical cohesion can be very effective for ranking text units in the context of text analysis and information extraction.
